title: Oceans
description: The concept is the ocean and the sea — waves, tides, salt water, shores and marine life — as a natural setting. It is contrasted with other natural settings described the same way, such as forests, fields and mountains. Contrast: forests, fields and mountains as natural settings.
inspiration: written by DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-ds4-q2 from the request: The ocean and the sea: waves, tides, salt water, shores and marine life, against other natural settings (forests, fields, mountains) described the same way.
contrast: forests, fields and mountains as natural settings
